meanings.en: dull, bleak and depressing; boring
meanings.exampleEn: It was a dreary, rainy afternoon with nothing to do.
meanings.exampleTr: Yapacak hiçbir şeyin olmadığı kasvetli, yağmurlu bir öğleden sonraydı.

meanings.en: to let liquid flow slowly in drops or a thin stream
meanings.exampleEn: The baby began to dribble down its chin.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeğin çenesinden salyalar akmaya başladı.

meanings.en: to move a ball forward with small touches or bounces
meanings.exampleEn: He dribbled past two defenders and scored.
meanings.exampleTr: İki savunmacıyı topu sürerek geçti ve gol attı.

meanings.en: to force an enemy or attacker to retreat
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers managed to drive back the invading army.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler işgalci orduyu geri püskürtmeyi başardı.

meanings.en: light rain falling in fine drops
meanings.exampleEn: We went for a walk despite the light drizzle.
meanings.exampleTr: Hafif çisentiye rağmen yürüyüşe çıktık.

meanings.en: to pour a thin stream of liquid over food
meanings.exampleEn: Drizzle some olive oil over the salad.
meanings.exampleTr: Salatanın üzerine biraz zeytinyağı gezdir.

meanings.en: an unmanned aircraft controlled remotely
meanings.exampleEn: The photographer used a drone to film the coastline.
meanings.exampleTr: Fotoğrafçı kıyı şeridini çekmek için bir drone kullandı.

meanings.en: a low continuous humming sound
meanings.exampleEn: The drone of the engine made her sleepy.
meanings.exampleTr: Motorun monoton uğultusu onu uykulu yaptı.

meanings.en: the state of being sleepy and sluggish
meanings.exampleEn: This medicine may cause drowsiness, so do not drive.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ilaç uyku hali yapabilir, bu yüzden araç kullanma.

meanings.en: the state of being drunk from alcohol
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for drunkenness in public.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamuya açık yerde sarhoşluktan tutuklandı.

meanings.en: having two parts, aspects or functions
meanings.exampleEn: She holds dual citizenship in France and Canada.
meanings.exampleTr: Fransa ve Kanada'da çifte vatandaşlığı var.

meanings.en: a tube or channel that carries air, liquid or cables
meanings.exampleEn: Warm air flows through the heating duct into each room.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcak hava ısıtma kanalından her odaya akar.

meanings.en: deceitful behaviour; being dishonest by acting differently in different situations
meanings.exampleEn: His duplicity was revealed when both partners compared his stories.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ortağı da onun anlattıklarını karşılaştırınca ikiyüzlülüğü ortaya çıktı.

meanings.en: able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out
meanings.exampleEn: These boots are durable enough for years of hiking.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu botlar yıllarca yürüyüş yapacak kadar dayanıklı.

meanings.en: throughout or at some point in a period of time
meanings.exampleEn: She fell asleep during the film.
meanings.exampleTr: Film sırasında uyuyakaldı.

meanings.en: every one of two or more things considered separately
meanings.exampleEn: Each student received a certificate.
meanings.exampleTr: Her öğrenci bir sertifika aldı.

meanings.en: used to show that each of two or more people does something to the other(s)
meanings.exampleEn: The two friends helped each other with their homework.
meanings.exampleTr: İki arkadaş ödevlerinde birbirlerine yardım etti.

meanings.en: a small earphone that fits inside the ear
meanings.exampleEn: She put in one earbud to listen to music while jogging.
meanings.exampleTr: Koşarken müzik dinlemek için bir kulaklığı kulağına taktı.

meanings.en: a period in which something is done without difficulty or trouble
meanings.exampleEn: The team did not have an easy time winning the final.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım finali kazanırken hiç kolay bir dönem geçirmedi.

meanings.en: the hard outer covering of an egg
meanings.exampleEn: Be careful not to get any eggshell in the bowl.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaseye yumurta kabuğu kaçırmamaya dikkat et.

meanings.en: excessively concerned with oneself; selfish
meanings.exampleEn: His egoistic attitude made teamwork almost impossible.
meanings.exampleTr: Bencil tutumu takım çalışmasını neredeyse imkânsız hale getirdi.

meanings.en: a thick warm quilt filled with soft feathers or down
meanings.exampleEn: On cold nights she snuggled under a heavy eiderdown.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk gecelerde ağır bir kuş tüyü yorganın altına kıvrılırdı.

meanings.en: the number 8
meanings.exampleEn: There are eight players on the team.
meanings.exampleTr: Takımda sekiz oyuncu var.

meanings.en: the number 18
meanings.exampleEn: You must be eighteen to vote in this country.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ülkede oy vermek için on sekiz yaşında olmalısın.

meanings.en: the number 80
meanings.exampleEn: My grandmother turned eighty last week.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannem geçen hafta seksen yaşına girdi.

meanings.en: the act of forcing or throwing someone or something out
meanings.exampleEn: The pilot's ejection from the cockpit saved his life.
meanings.exampleTr: Pilotun kokpitten fırlatılması hayatını kurtardı.

meanings.en: the quality of being detailed, complicated and carefully worked out
meanings.exampleEn: The elaborateness of the wedding decorations amazed every guest.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğün süslemelerinin ayrıntılılığı her konuğu hayran bıraktı.

meanings.en: older, especially of two family members
meanings.exampleEn: My elder brother lives in London.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağabeyim Londra'da yaşıyor.

meanings.tr: yaşlı kimse, büyük, ihtiyar heyeti üyesi
meanings.en: an older, respected person in a community
meanings.exampleEn: The village elders gathered to discuss the dispute.
meanings.exampleTr: Köyün ileri gelenleri anlaşmazlığı görüşmek için toplandı.

meanings.en: oldest, especially of three or more family members
meanings.exampleEn: Their eldest daughter is studying medicine.
meanings.exampleTr: En büyük kızları tıp okuyor.

meanings.en: the number 11
meanings.exampleEn: The train leaves at eleven o'clock.
meanings.exampleTr: Tren saat on birde kalkıyor.

meanings.en: a small imaginary creature with magical powers and pointed ears
meanings.exampleEn: In the story, a little elf granted three wishes.
meanings.exampleTr: Hikayede küçük bir elf üç dilek verdi.

meanings.en: to escape from or avoid someone or something skilfully
meanings.exampleEn: The thief managed to elude the police for months.
meanings.exampleTr: Hırsız aylarca polisten yakayı sıyırmayı başardı.

meanings.en: to fail to be understood or remembered by someone
meanings.exampleEn: The answer to the puzzle continued to elude her.
meanings.exampleTr: Bulmacanın cevabı bir türlü aklına gelmedi.

meanings.en: to fix something firmly and deeply into a surrounding mass
meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon removed a piece of glass embedded in his hand.
meanings.exampleTr: Cerrah elinin içine gömülü bir cam parçasını çıkardı.

meanings.en: to place content within another document, file or system
meanings.exampleEn: You can embed a video directly into your web page.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir videoyu doğrudan web sayfana yerleştirebilirsin.

meanings.en: a decorative detail added to make something more attractive
meanings.exampleEn: The dress had delicate embellishments of beads and lace.
meanings.exampleTr: Elbisenin boncuk ve dantelden ince süslemeleri vardı.

meanings.en: an added detail that makes a story more interesting but is not strictly true
meanings.exampleEn: His account of the trip was full of embellishments.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezi anlatısı süslemelerle doluydu.

meanings.en: the small glowing pieces of wood or coal left after a fire
meanings.exampleEn: We warmed our hands over the dying embers of the campfire.
meanings.exampleTr: Ellerimizi kamp ateşinin sönmekte olan közlerinde ısıttık.

meanings.en: made braver or more confident to do something
meanings.exampleEn: Emboldened by the crowd's support, she spoke her mind.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalığın desteğiyle cesaretlenerek düşüncelerini açıkça söyledi.

meanings.en: a person sent as a representative to deliver a message or negotiate
meanings.exampleEn: The king sent an emissary to negotiate peace.
meanings.exampleTr: Kral barışı görüşmek için bir elçi gönderdi.

meanings.en: based on observation and experiment rather than theory
meanings.exampleEn: There is little empirical evidence to support that claim.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu iddiayı destekleyen çok az deneysel kanıt var.

meanings.en: the supply of and demand for workers and jobs
meanings.exampleEn: Recent graduates are entering a competitive employment market.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni mezunlar rekabetçi bir iş piyasasına giriyor.

meanings.en: the state of containing nothing
meanings.exampleEn: The emptiness of the vast desert was overwhelming.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçsuz bucaksız çölün boşluğu insanı bunaltıyordu.

meanings.en: a feeling of having no purpose or meaning
meanings.exampleEn: After the funeral he felt a deep emptiness inside.
meanings.exampleTr: Cenazeden sonra içinde derin bir boşluk hissetti.

meanings.en: a person or thing that makes something possible
meanings.exampleEn: Technology is a key enabler of remote work.
meanings.exampleTr: Teknoloji, uzaktan çalışmanın önemli bir kolaylaştırıcısıdır.

meanings.en: someone who encourages another's harmful behaviour by helping them avoid its consequences
meanings.exampleEn: By covering his debts, she became an enabler of his gambling.
meanings.exampleTr: Borçlarını kapatarak onun kumar bağımlılığını körükleyen kişi oldu.

meanings.en: the process of making a bill into a law
meanings.exampleEn: The enactment of the new law took several months.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasanın çıkarılması birkaç ay sürdü.

meanings.en: the acting out of a scene or event
meanings.exampleEn: The students prepared an enactment of the historic battle.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler tarihi savaşın bir canlandırmasını hazırladı.

meanings.en: to delight or charm someone greatly
meanings.exampleEn: The singer's voice enchanted the entire audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Şarkıcının sesi tüm seyirciyi büyüledi.

meanings.en: to put a magic spell on someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: The witch enchanted the mirror so it would speak.
meanings.exampleTr: Cadı aynayı konuşsun diye büyüledi.

meanings.en: delightful and charming
meanings.exampleEn: They spent an enchanting evening by the lake.
meanings.exampleTr: Göl kenarında büyüleyici bir akşam geçirdiler.

meanings.en: a magic spell or the state of being under one
meanings.exampleEn: The castle was said to be under a powerful enchantment.
meanings.exampleTr: Şatonun güçlü bir büyünün etkisi altında olduğu söyleniyordu.

meanings.en: a feeling of great delight or fascination
meanings.exampleEn: The children watched the fireworks with pure enchantment.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar havai fişekleri tam bir hayranlıkla izledi.

meanings.en: to convert information into a coded form
meanings.exampleEn: The software encodes the data before sending it.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılım veriyi göndermeden önce kodlar.

meanings.en: to change information into a secret code so it cannot be read without a key
meanings.exampleEn: The app encrypts all your messages end to end.
meanings.exampleTr: Uygulama tüm mesajlarını uçtan uca şifreler.

meanings.en: inspiring love or affection
meanings.exampleEn: Her shy smile was one of her most endearing qualities.
meanings.exampleTr: Utangaç gülümsemesi, onun en sevimli özelliklerinden biriydi.
